correctness.rationale: From eta=0 and uniform rank marginal, the conditional mean is exactly 1/2. Conditional independence of V and V' given U plus Jensen yields E|V-V'|>=E|V-1/2|=1/4, hence xi<=1/4 by the paper's normalized identity. Nonnegativity follows from conditional-CDF variance. Equality is equivalent to conditional laws of support size <=2 by strictness of Jensen if mass occurs below and above a middle support point. The singular prior construction attains the cap. For absolutely continuous checkerboard c_m, both uniform margins, eta=0, and exact xi=1/4-1/(4m) follow by elementary interval integration; checker.py passed 128 rational cases and four boundary cases. Non-atomic conditional laws cannot attain Jensen equality. No finite tests are promoted to infinite proof.

value.rationale: Ansari–Rockel explicitly pose sharpness of an attainable two-dependence-measure region as open and provide only an inner segment at zero copula correlation ratio. The universal ceiling closes the natural zero-regression section, characterizes exactly its singular extreme conditional fibers and proves a qualitatively different but sharp density supremum using an explicit family. This supplies a meaningful boundary classification distinguishing mean independence from full distributional independence, not a renamed known endpoint example. The positive-eta classification and finite-sample inference remain unproved.
